cmd.exe /d /q /c for /f %G in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do node %G/hooks/scripts/runtime-dispatcher.mjs PreToolUse
cmd.exe /d /q /c for /f %G in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') do node %G/hooks/scripts/runtime-dispatcher.mjs PostToolUse
